parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key you generate for this attempt (e.g. a UUID). Optional: without it every call is a new request. Resending the same key (after a timeout or network cut) returns the original response instead of creating a second operation; the same key with a different body returns 409.

example_prompt: Let the customer retry a failed SasPay payment, optionally on another network.

methods.description: Codes réseau à essayer, dans l'ordre. Défaut : réseau d'origine de la transaction.

gotchas: Retrying reuses the same transaction and id; it never creates a new transaction.
Only incoming payments can be retried: a payout returns 400. A FAILED payment is retryable (that is what this endpoint is for); 409 is for the other terminal states.
Send an Idempotency-Key: without it a network retry relaunches the payment a second time. Reusing a key with a different body, or while the first call is still running, returns 409.

The retry can switch the customer to a hosted page: on the sandbox, a failed mtn_ci push retried with no body came back with a checkout_url (status still FAILED until the customer pays), so check checkout_url on every retry.
open_questions: How SasPay tells sandbox from production on the same host, https://api.saspay.me (sandbox test runs and the production OpenAPI both use it): key type or account mode — not documented in this spec set.

spans: ne crée jamais de nouvelle transaction, réutilise le même `id`.
La transaction ciblée est un flux sortant (payout), non réessayable via cet endpoint
sans lui, un retry réseau relance une seconde fois le paiement.
Même clé, 1<sup>er</sup> appel encore en cours
